annotations.title: Autonomous Goal-to-MCP Tool Sequence Router & Cost Planner

description: Maps a natural-language agent goal to an ordered sequence of Diogenes MCP tool calls with exact endpoint paths, JSON-RPC 2.0 payloads, and cumulative satoshi cost estimates. Use when an autonomous agent needs to plan which MCP tools to chain together to solve a multi-step objective within a satoshi budget; for compiling a static XML system prompt rather than an executable MCP tool call sequence, use compile_xml_agent_prompt instead. Read-only edge call (32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'objective' ('budget_preference' defaults to 'lowest_sats_deterministic'), uses '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats); HTTP 400 if invalid.

budget_preference.description: Cost vs depth routing trade-off; defaults to 'lowest_sats_deterministic' when omitted.

objective.description: Natural-language description of the workflow goal to route across MCP tools.

name: route_mcp_workflow_plan

estimated_total_sats.description: Cumulative satoshi cost of the planned tool sequence.

recommended_sequence.description: Ordered tool execution steps with tool name, endpoint, and cost_sats.

title: Autonomous Goal-to-MCP Tool Sequence Router & Cost Planner
